dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the families of the specific crew members, the Department of the Army, and the Department of the Air Force.
dimensions.evidence: a monument honoring the crew members of Zeus 95 who were killed in action on March 12, 2026

dimensions.assessment: Involves specific construction and placement of a memorial monument rather than broad societal policy changes.
dimensions.evidence: construct, install, and maintain the monument

dimensions.assessment: Requires the Secretary of the Air Force to pay all costs necessary for site preparation, construction, installation, and maintenance, but does not specify a total dollar amount.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of the Air Force agrees to pay all costs necessary for preparation of the site

dimensions.assessment: A narrow administrative mandate directed at specific military departments regarding a single monument.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of the Army shall place in Arlington National Cemetery a monument

dimensions.assessment: Results in a permanent physical monument at Arlington National Cemetery or its entrance.

missing_information: Total estimated monetary cost of constructing and maintaining the monument.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the placement of a specific monument honoring crew members of Zeus 95 in Arlington National Cemetery or at its entrance, funded and constructed through an agreement with the Secretary of the Air Force.
